# 2026 - Annual Town Election

## Information You Need to Know!

It's Annual Town Election Time!

  * Unofficial Election Results - CLICK HERE!
  * Annual Town Election will be held on Tuesday, May 19, 2026.  Polls will be open 7:00AM - 8:00PM
  * Last Day to Register to Vote is Saturday, May 9, 2026
  * The Town Clerk's Office and the Board of Registrars will be holding a Special Voter Registration Session on Saturday, May 9, 2026 at Town Hall from 9:00am to 5:00pm. Persons interested in voting in the May 19, 2026 Annual Town Election who are not yet registered to vote may register in person during this session.
  * In Person Early Voting - THERE WILL BE NO IN PERSON EARLY VOTING SESSIONS FOR THIS ELECTION.
  * The Ballot - There is one seat for Moderator, one seat for Select Board, two seats for D-Y Regional School Committee, and one seat for the Housing Authority on the ballot this year. There is a possibility of ballot questions being added.   A Sample Ballot will be posted here once ready.
  * The Candidates - We will update this information once candidates have been certified to be placed on the ballot.
  *              Select Board  (Vote for One) - Mark R. Forest
  *              DY Regional School District Committee  (Vote for Two) - Joe B, Glynn
  *              Moderator (Vote for One) - James Kevin Saben
  *              Yarmouth Housing Authority - Joe B. Glynn
  * Sample Ballot - Click Here!
  * Vote by Mail - If you are interested in voting by mail, please submit an application for this election!
  * VOTE BY MAIL and ABSENTEE Applications are only good for one CALENDAR YEAR.
  * The deadline to receive a vote by mail request is Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 5:00PM.
  * Vote by Mail Application CLICK HERE!--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
